data.name: Elemental Focus
data.description: The fire master can prepare one additional spell per day of each level she can cast, but it must have the fire descriptor. Preparing a water spell takes up two spell slots of the same level. You take a -4 penalty on any skill checks made when crafting a magic item that has a water spell as a prerequisite.
